title: Multi-MCP 403 (Upstream)
style: cyberpunk industrial, glitch percussion, modem static, distorted synth bass, male technical lead, female robotic harmony, 808 stabs, 100 BPM, paranoid, technical, vinyl crackle, error tones
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Linear connector installed
Always allow on twenty-one tools
Get team visible, all read-only
Same session four-oh-three rules

Not a permission misconfiguration
Not at the user layer
Upstream issue — auth or gateway
OAuth token — the prayer

[Pre-Chorus]
Multi-MCP four-oh-three
Slack, Notion, Linear
Hidden meter on Claude Design
Weekly allocation in the air

[Chorus]
Four-oh-three, four-oh-three
Forbidden where I should be free
Three connectors in the dark
Three systems all marked
Four-oh-three, four-oh-three
This is upstream, can't you see
Not the user, not the tools
It's the gateway breaking the rules

[Verse 2]
Content filter false positive
Legitimate self-sovereign creative
request_id req_011
CaCxLfZEjBBZvNvbzXA81
Log it. File it. Trace it back.
This is signal. This is a fact.

[Bridge]
MCP — forbidden
MCP — forbidden
The meter is hidden
The filter is bidden
Four-oh-three at the gate
Four-oh-three is my fate
Upstream — not user state

[Outro]
Multi-MCP four-oh-three
Documented, time-stamped, free
Multi-MCP four-oh-three
The ticket and the tea
request_id, log, repeat
Upstream gateway — incomplete
